title: Map of the city of Chicago
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; UW-Milwaukee Libraries
notes: Projected from a trigonometrical survey at approximately 1:20,000; primary annual control for 1872. Local file is a reduced derivative of the 7,665-by-9,083-pixel Commons original.

title: 1873 Map of the City of Chicago
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; HJB Maps source
notes: Strong city-extent and transportation reference; not a systematic building-footprint survey.

title: Mitchell's plan of the city of Chicago, Illinois
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; Geographicus Rare Antique Maps source
notes: Approximately 1:31,680 annual city reference. Use the separate 1874 bird's-eye only as pictorial context for the July fire event.

title: The City of Chicago, showing the burnt district
credit_line: Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division, shelf G4104.C6A3 1874 .C5; public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Pictorial event reference only, not a fire-footprint geometry source. Do not warp or derive building fate/polygon boundaries from it. Local file is a reduced derivative of the 6,384-by-4,576-pixel Commons original.

title: 1875 Map of the City of Chicago
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; Geographicus Rare Antique Maps source
notes: Useful annual reference; institutional repository metadata should be strengthened before survey-grade use.

title: Map of Chicago City
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; David Rumsey Historical Map Collection 1159.006
notes: Approximately 1:35,500. Local file is a reduced derivative of the 4,053-by-5,158-pixel Commons original.

title: Mitchell's plan of the city of Chicago, Illinois
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; source credited by Commons to Antique Maps & Globes
notes: Approximately 1:31,680; annual extent/street reference rather than building inventory. Institutional repository metadata should be added before survey-grade use.

title: Travelers' and shippers' railway guide map of Chicago
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; Norman B. Leventhal Map Center/Boston Public Library
notes: Approximately 1:12,000 and therefore a strong transportation and block-scale annual reference. Local file is a reduced derivative of the 6,828-by-8,845-pixel Commons original.

title: Bird's Eye View of Chicago, 1879
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; Chicago Historical Society ICHi-05679
notes: Primary visual/massing reference, not cadastral geometry; use qualitatively and do not warp as a survey map.

title: Andreas volume III, printed page 60 — first-year rebuilding totals
credit_line: A. T. Andreas, History of Chicago, volume III (1886); Internet Archive scan
notes: Supports first-year height, frontage, division-cost, fire-limit, material, bridge, and viaduct evidence.

title: Andreas volume III, printed page 67 — 1877–1885 permit/building table
credit_line: A. T. Andreas, History of Chicago, volume III (1886); Internet Archive scan
notes: Supports annual building, frontage, story, façade-material, partial-use, and nominal-cost measurements.
